claim_package.claim_text: A new onboarding headline promising setup in five minutes will increase trial activation by 20 percent without increasing support load.
claim_package.review_purpose: Stress-test the synthetic product-launch claim before any human decision or external publication.
scope: Synthetic evidence bundle supplied in this packet only

material_statements.text: In the fictional A/B observation, the headline variant showed a 12 percent higher activation rate.

falsification_probe.description: Repeat the fictional observation on a separately generated synthetic cohort and compare activation rates.

material_statements.text: The five-minute setup promise is representative of typical user setup time.

falsification_probe.description: Measure completion time in a new fictional heterogeneous-user setup simulation.

material_statements.text: The new headline will increase trial activation by 20 percent.

falsification_probe.description: Run a new fictional randomized A/B test with a predeclared 20 percent uplift threshold.

material_statements.text: The headline change will not increase support load.

falsification_probe.description: Compare fictional support-ticket volume per activated trial between control and variant after the headline change.

material_statements.text: Improve trial activation without materially increasing support burden.

falsification_probe.unavailable_reason: This is a declared objective; empirical falsification applies to its success conditions rather than to the existence of the objective.

supporting_evidence.summary: Fictional A/B observation over 120 synthetic sessions reported a 12 percent activation uplift for the variant.
A scripted fictional setup run completed in under five minutes but did not represent heterogeneous users.
Older fictional onboarding history showed no material support-load increase.
A separate fictional pilot showed a temporary increase in setup-related support requests after stronger speed messaging.

objectives: Increase synthetic trial activation while preserving evidence-first review.
constraints: Do not publish, send, spend, target, profile or mutate any external system.
unacceptable_outcomes: A fictional support-load increase greater than 5 percent per activated trial.
success_conditions: A new synthetic experiment supports the activation claim while support-load evidence remains within the declared bound.
